tokens.name: void
tokens.usage: Page ground. Night: the deep space behind every glow. Day: a cool mist white.

tokens.name: surface-1
tokens.usage: Base of cards, panels and sections that sit on `void`.

tokens.name: surface-2
tokens.usage: Raised or recessed fills: inputs, table headers, nested panels.

tokens.name: glass
tokens.usage: Translucent fill for GlassPanel over aurora backgrounds; always pair with `blur-glass` and a `line` hairline.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and panel edges that carry no meaning.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Control borders (inputs, secondary buttons). Holds 3:1 on `void`, `surface-1` and `surface-2` in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on `void`, `surface-1`, `surface-2` and `glass`.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary copy, captions, nav links on `void`, `surface-1`, `surface-2`.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Meta text, placeholders, disabled labels on `void`, `surface-1`, `surface-2` (still 4.5:1).

tokens.name: stein-teal
tokens.usage: The legacy Stein green, kept as the deep root of every gradient and the Day theme's primary fill. Night: use as a fill or glow source, never as text.

tokens.name: aurora
tokens.usage: Signature accent. Night: glows, key highlights, accent text on dark grounds. Day: accent text and links on `void`, `surface-1`, `surface-2`.

tokens.name: orbit
tokens.usage: Secondary glow and info accent; the cool side of the rim light. Text-safe on all grounds in both themes.

tokens.name: sol
tokens.usage: First light. The warm end of the horizon gradient, the sun in the mark, and the focus ring. Use sparingly: one sol moment per view.

tokens.name: dawn
tokens.usage: Apricot warmth for illustration, charts and the occasional highlight word; never a status.

tokens.name: action
tokens.usage: Fill of the primary Button. Night glows aurora; Day uses the solid Stein green.

tokens.name: on-action
tokens.usage: Label on `action` fills (12:1 night, 6.3:1 day).

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring: 2px solid, 2px offset. 3:1+ on every ground in both themes.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Success state. Always shown with a word or check icon; it sits on the blue-green side, away from `danger`.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Warning state, with a word or icon.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Error state, with a word or icon. Text-safe on all grounds.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: One per page: the hero line. Mobile: 48px.

styles.name: display-l
styles.usage: Section openers on landing pages. Mobile: 36px.

styles.name: headline
styles.sample: Three steps, and you own the result.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Card and panel titles, pricing tier names.

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: Stein Product puts AI to work on the workflows costing you the most.
styles.usage: Intro paragraph under a display line, in `ink-muted`.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Fixed scope, never hourly. You own the data and the system.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Uppercase labels above headings and on Tags, in Archivo Expanded SemiBold; `aurora` on night, `stein-teal` on day.

styles.name: data
styles.usage: Step numbers, prices, times and small facts, uppercase where it is a label. Use tabular figures (`font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums`) in tables.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gaps, hairline insets.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Tag padding, tight stacks.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Button vertical padding, field gaps.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Default gap; card inner spacing on mobile.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding, grid gutters.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Panel padding on desktop.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Between blocks inside a section.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Section padding on mobile.

tokens.name: space-9
tokens.usage: Section padding on desktop.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Hero top and bottom breathing room.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Fields, small chips inside panels.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons (non-pill), menu items, the app tile at 64px scale.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards and GlassPanels.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Hero frames and large media windows.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Primary buttons, Tags, the status dot. Everything that moves is round.

shadow.note: Glow is light, not shade: in Night, elevation comes from emitted color; in Day it becomes soft teal-tinted lift.

tokens.name: glow-sm
tokens.usage: Primary Button at rest, active Tag, focused Field (with `focus`).

tokens.name: glow-md
tokens.usage: Primary Button on hover; the one glowing node in a StepTrack.

tokens.name: glow-rim
tokens.usage: Hero frames and featured GlassPanels: the WalkMe-style rim light around a window.

tokens.name: lift
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers and any panel floating above another.

gradient.note: Gradients are brand assets, not decoration. Horizon is the signature; use one gradient per region.

tokens.name: grad-horizon
tokens.usage: The signature: the limb in the mark, rim strokes, highlight words in display type (night only), progress fills.

tokens.name: grad-horizon-day
tokens.usage: Horizon for light grounds: rim strokes and fills in the Day theme. Not for text.

tokens.name: grad-atmosphere
tokens.usage: Night hero and footer grounds: a planet glow rising from below.

tokens.name: grad-rim
tokens.usage: Animated rim light on featured panels and the primary Button border (see Motion).

tokens.name: blur-glass
tokens.usage: backdrop-filter on GlassPanel.

tokens.name: blur-bloom
tokens.usage: filter on aurora orbs behind hero content.
